submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F3 with 5.5 mm plates. Among all eligible candidate absorbers and tested plate thicknesses in the allowed 2–10 mm range, the refined simulation scan gives the best 100 GeV energy resolution for F3 at 5.5 mm: 3.147%. This improves on the best coarse-grid result, F3 at 6 mm with 3.177%, and is better than the best observed F2 result, 3.908% at 5 mm, and best observed F1 result, 5.149% at 4 mm.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: The selected configuration has the best recorded refined resolution: Absorber-F3 at 5.5 mm gives 3.147%, compared with F3 5.25 mm at 3.156%, F3 6 mm at 3.177%, best F2 at 3.908%, and best F1 at 5.149%.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 was marked eligible (absorber_F3_eligible = 1) and no hands-on maintenance violation was found (absorber_F3_hands_on_violation_found = 0).
The recommended plate thickness is 5.5 mm, which lies within the allowed 2–10 mm interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F3 with 5.5 mm plates.
